name: hrms
description: Modular HRMS — a modular-monolith Human Resource Management System.

scripts.build:contracts: npm run build -w @hrms/shared && npm run build -w @hrms/ui
scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build -w @hrms/api && npm run build -w @hrms/worker && npm run build -w @hrms/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck -w @hrms/api && npm run typecheck -w @hrms/worker && npm run typecheck -w @hrms/web
